name: Babar Azam
quote: A bat is more than just a piece of equipment, it becomes part of your game. With CA, I get the perfect balance, feel, and confidence to express myself at the crease.
bio: Babar Azam was born on October 15, 1994 . He is indeed one of the most elegant batsmen in recent cricket history; he is consistent and a right-hander top order player who combined technical brilliance with a calm manner that makes him a vital player for the Pakistan cricket team as well as widely admired by fans globally.

A cricketing career starts for Babar on the streets of Lahore. He started loving cricket on the streets of Lahore, and then his domestic cricket performance was of good quality with determination, which subsequently earned him a place in the national side. His first international match came in an ODI versus Zimbabwe on 31st May 2015, and gradually he became one of the most reliable batsmen in the world.

Among his career highlights, the back-to-back centuries Babar scored during the ODI series in 2016 against the West Indies established his status as a batting prodigy. He maintained his good performance time and again in ICC events and bilateral series, contributing a lot to Pakistan's victories.

Babar has registered many records in international cricket; he is also one of the fastest players to score 1,000 runs in T20 Internationals . He took Pakistan to a historical milestone and won the series from ICC tours, which bagged him various accolades as a captain.

He is among the few batsmen who can play anchor innings and make something out of even adverse conditions. He is a stalwart in the batting unit of Pakistan, a modern-day cricket legend with commendable skills and temperament that would inspire the newer generations.

name: Shadab Khan
quote: For me, confidence at the crease starts with trusting your equipment. A CA bat gives me the balance, control, and freedom to play my natural game.
bio: Shadab Khan is one of Pakistan's premier all-rounders, renowned for his dynamic leg-spin bowling, explosive lower-order batting, and exceptional fielding. Born on 4 October 1998 in Mianwali, Punjab, Shadab rose rapidly through Pakistan's domestic cricket structure before making an immediate impact on the international stage in 2017. His ability to contribute in all three departments of the game has made him one of the most valuable white-ball cricketers in world cricket.

Shadab first came into the spotlight through impressive performances in domestic cricket and the Pakistan Super League, where his variations, control, and composure under pressure attracted national selectors. He made his T20 International debut against the West Indies in March 2017, taking three wickets and earning the Player of the Match award. Just weeks later, he made his ODI debut against the same opposition before receiving his maiden Test cap against the West Indies in Barbados.

One of the defining moments of his career came later that year when he played an important role in Pakistan's historic triumph at the 2017 ICC Champions Trophy . His economical bowling and crucial wickets throughout the tournament helped Pakistan lift their first Champions Trophy title, including the memorable final victory over India at The Oval.

Since then, Shadab has become an integral member of Pakistan's leadership group. He has captained Pakistan in T20 Internationals on multiple occasions and has frequently served as vice-captain across white-ball formats. Renowned for his calm temperament, tactical awareness, and leadership qualities, he has consistently stepped up whenever entrusted with additional responsibility.

Beyond international cricket, Shadab has established himself as one of the world's leading franchise all-rounders. He has represented Islamabad United in the Pakistan Super League since its early seasons and has also featured in global competitions including The Hundred, Big Bash League, Caribbean Premier League, Vitality Blast, Lanka Premier League , and other premier T20 tournaments. His experience across different conditions has further enhanced his reputation as one of the game's most complete T20 cricketers.

As a CA Sports Brand Ambassador , Shadab Khan represents passion, resilience, and excellence. His all-round abilities, fearless attitude, and relentless pursuit of success perfectly align with CA Sports' commitment to producing high-performance cricket equipment trusted by international athletes around the world.

name: Asif Ali
quote: When it's time to take the game on, hesitation isn't an option. I need a bat built for intent, power, and those moments when one shot can change everything.
bio: Asif Ali is an explosive middle-order batter renowned for his exceptional power-hitting and ability to finish matches under pressure. Born on 1 October 1991 in Faisalabad, Pakistan , Asif rose from Pakistan's domestic cricket circuit to become one of the country's most recognized white-ball finishers. His fearless batting style, clean striking, and ability to accelerate during the closing overs have earned him a reputation as one of Pakistan's most dangerous T20 specialists.

Asif began his professional career representing Faisalabad before making his mark in domestic T20 cricket. His breakthrough came with Islamabad United in the inaugural Pakistan Super League, where his powerful finishing ability played a key role in the franchise's success. Consistent performances in domestic cricket and the PSL earned him a call-up to Pakistan's national side in 2018.

He made his T20 International debut against the West Indies in April 2018 before making his One Day International debut against Zimbabwe later that year. Over the following years, Asif established himself as Pakistan's designated finisher in limited-overs cricket, regularly producing impactful cameos during run chases and high-pressure situations.

One of the defining periods of his international career came during the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2021 , where he played several match-winning innings. His unbeaten 27 off 12 balls against New Zealand and 25 off 7 balls against Afghanistan, including four consecutive sixes against Karim Janat, were instrumental in Pakistan's victories and highlighted his ability to change games within a few deliveries. These performances cemented his reputation as one of the world's most dangerous finishers in T20 cricket.

Beyond international cricket, Asif has represented franchises around the world, including competitions such as the Pakistan Super League (PSL), Caribbean Premier League (CPL), Bangladesh Premier League (BPL), Global T20 Canada, Abu Dhabi T10, The Hundred , and several other international tournaments. His extensive franchise experience has made him a sought-after power hitter in T20 leagues worldwide.

As a CA Sports Champion , Asif Ali represents strength, confidence, and fearless cricket. His aggressive batting style and ability to perform in pressure situations embody the power and performance that define CA Sports' cricket equipment .

bio: Tanzid Hasan Tamim is an exciting left-handed opening batter who has emerged as one of Bangladesh's brightest young cricketing talents. Born on 1 December 2000 in Bogura, Bangladesh, Tanzid is known for his positive intent at the top of the order, elegant stroke play, and fearless approach against both pace and spin. Having progressed through Bangladesh's age-group system, he has developed into one of the country's most promising opening batters across all formats of the game.

Tanzid first gained national recognition through consistent performances in domestic and youth cricket, earning selection for Bangladesh's squad in the 2020 ICC Under-19 Cricket World Cup. Throughout the tournament, he played an important role as Bangladesh secured its first-ever ICC World Cup title at any level, finishing among his team's leading run-scorers and demonstrating the temperament required for international cricket.

Following his Under-19 success, Tanzid continued his development through Bangladesh's domestic structure, representing Rajshahi Division, Prime Bank Cricket Club, and several Bangladesh Premier League franchises. His performances for Bangladesh A and the Bangladesh Emerging Team further strengthened his credentials and ultimately earned him his maiden international call-up.

He made his One Day International debut during the 2023 Asia Cup against Sri Lanka before making his T20 International debut against Zimbabwe in 2024. His confident starts, attacking mindset, and ability to capitalize on the powerplay quickly established him as one of Bangladesh's preferred opening batters in white-ball cricket. In 2026, he earned his maiden Test cap, becoming an all-format international cricketer for Bangladesh.

Beyond international cricket, Tanzid has built valuable experience in franchise competitions, representing teams such as Khulna Tigers, Chattogram Challengers, Dhaka Capitals, and Peshawar Zalmi in the Pakistan Super League. Competing alongside some of the world's leading cricketers has further accelerated his growth and enhanced his reputation as a modern attacking opener.

As a CA Sports Brand Ambassador, Tanzid Hasan represents the next generation of international cricket. His fearless batting style, commitment to continuous improvement, and determination to succeed perfectly align with CA Sports' values of innovation, quality, and high-performance equipment trusted by elite cricketers around the world.

bio: Asif Khan is a powerful right-handed batter who has become one of the leading figures in UAE cricket through his aggressive stroke play and ability to score at an exceptional pace. Born on 15 February 1990 in Lahore, Pakistan , Asif began his cricketing journey in Pakistan before later establishing himself in the United Arab Emirates, where he earned international recognition as one of the country's most dangerous white-ball batters.

Before representing the UAE, Asif enjoyed a successful domestic career in Pakistan, playing first-class and List A cricket for Lahore and other regional teams. After relocating to the UAE, he continued his development through domestic competitions and consistently impressed with his powerful batting, eventually earning selection for the national team. His performances in domestic cricket and franchise tournaments highlighted his ability to dominate bowling attacks and finish innings under pressure.

Asif made his One Day International debut against Oman in March 2022 and immediately established himself as a key member of the UAE batting lineup. In 2023, he made his T20 International debut against New Zealand before producing one of the greatest innings in UAE cricket history later that year. Against Nepal, Asif smashed an unbeaten 151 from just 145 balls in an ODI , including a breathtaking century from only 41 deliveries , setting the record for the fastest ODI century by an Associate Nation batter and the joint fourth-fastest ODI century in men's international cricket .

Known for his clean hitting and fearless approach, Asif has become one of the UAE's most dependable middle-order batters. His ability to accelerate an innings, clear the boundary consistently, and perform in high-pressure situations has made him one of the country's most valuable white-ball cricketers.

Alongside his international career, Asif has built an impressive franchise résumé by featuring in tournaments including the ILT20, Abu Dhabi T10, and other major UAE domestic competitions. He has represented franchises such as MI Emirates, Gulf Giants, Team Abu Dhabi, UAE Bulls, and Deccan Gladiators, gaining valuable experience alongside some of the world's leading cricketers.

As a CA Sports Brand Ambassador , Asif Khan reflects the brand's commitment to power, innovation, and elite performance. His fearless batting style, professionalism, and determination embody the qualities that define CA Sports equipment at the highest level of international cricket.

name: Jhonson Charles
quote: I play an attacking brand of cricket, so I need a bat that lets me play with freedom and intent. CA gives me the feel, balance, and power I need to take the game on.
bio: Johnson Charles is a dynamic West Indian wicketkeeper-batter renowned for his explosive stroke play, fearless intent, and ability to dominate bowling attacks from the very first over. Born on 14 January 1989 in Castries, Saint Lucia, Charles has represented the West Indies across One Day Internationals (ODIs) and Twenty20 Internationals (T20Is) since making his international debut in 2011, establishing himself as one of the Caribbean's most destructive white-ball cricketers.

Charles developed through the domestic cricket system in Saint Lucia before representing the Windward Islands, where his aggressive batting and dependable wicketkeeping quickly attracted the attention of national selectors. He made his T20I debut against England in September 2011 before earning his ODI debut against Australia in March 2012. His consistent performances soon cemented his place as an explosive opening batter capable of changing the course of a match within a matter of overs.

One of the defining moments of Charles' early international career came during the 2012 ICC Men's T20 World Cup, where his attacking 84 against England played a crucial role in the West Indies' successful campaign. He later became a two-time ICC Men's T20 World Cup champion as a member of the victorious 2016 West Indies squad, further strengthening his reputation as a proven performer on the biggest stage.

Known for his clean ball-striking, aggressive powerplay batting, and fearless approach, Charles has delivered several memorable performances throughout his international career. In 2013, he registered back-to-back ODI centuries, while in 2023 he produced one of the greatest innings of his career, smashing 118 off just 46 balls against South Africa. The innings marked his maiden T20I century and became one of the fastest centuries ever scored by a West Indian in T20 International cricket.

Beyond international cricket, Charles has enjoyed an outstanding franchise career, becoming one of the most sought-after T20 specialists in the world. He has featured in leading competitions including the Caribbean Premier League (CPL), Pakistan Super League (PSL), Bangladesh Premier League (BPL), SA20, Global T20 Canada, ILT20, and several other prestigious tournaments. His success across diverse playing conditions highlights his adaptability, experience, and consistent ability to perform at the highest level of franchise cricket.

As a CA Sports Brand Ambassador, Johnson Charles embodies the brand's commitment to performance, innovation, and excellence. His aggressive batting style, match-winning mentality, and dedication to the game perfectly reflect the power, precision, and quality associated with CA cricket equipment, making him an ideal representative of the brand on the global stage.
